correctness.rationale: The graph and face predicate are explicit, and two finite face tests agree on all 2^14 subsets, finding 2257 simplices. Two complete acyclic Morse matchings each have 1121 disjoint pairs and critical cells (one vertex, thirteen dimension-five). Exhaustive Hasse DAG checks cover all 10150 codimension-one incidences in each matching. The resulting CW homotopy model is a point with 13 five-cells and therefore a wedge of 13 S5 integrally. Direct original mod-two simplicial boundary ranks and reduced Euler characteristic independently agree. The exact standalone verifier and executed output are included; all claims are finite.

value.rationale: The first forest complex of the smallest finite projective plane incidence graph is a natural exact topological invariant, not an arbitrary induced subgraph slice. Its nonpure six-dimensional facet geometry hides a complete integral wedge-of-thirteen-five-spheres homotopy classification; the motivating 2023 work treats other graph families. This supplies a distinct benchmark for exploring forest filtrations of cubic incidence graphs and higher-order planes, without asserting an unsupported general theorem.
